title: General Unit Steering
objective: Implement and validate post-class-rank norm-first subfactor-base steering so x^4-x-1 completes class and unit computation within 64 attempts and 10 seconds without regressing the C4 quintic
references: Hecke.jl 0.40 ClassGrpCtx and NfFactorBase (BSD-3-Clause; clean-room design reference)
PARI/GP buch2.c and related number-field class/unit algorithms (GPL; clean-room design reference only)

handoff.summary: Implemented producer-only fixed distinct-rational-p subfactor-base steering after exact class rank, exact norm screening before valuations, bounded numerical log filtering, append-only exact dependency deltas, and zero-width unit relation extensions. Steering caches are non-authoritative and absent from checkpoints: resume rescans the authenticated collector/presentation once, reconstructs the exact logarithm basis and dependency cursor, and restores the coefficient schedule from ideals_tested. Context-owned issuance snapshots, identity binding, cancellation, hostile mutation, checkpoint parity, and outer-hash tampering are tested. Frozen f0 baseline x^4-x-1 exhausted 64 attempts in 11.39s public / 10.72s relations at log rank 1/2; retained G1 completes in 1 attempt, 7 candidates, and 2 exact rows, with warm prepared-field samples 0.250-0.252s public / 0.144-0.145s relations after a 0.917s first observation. The C4 quintic remains exact at 10 attempts, 20 candidates, 21 rows, invariants (4,), rank 2, torsion 2, and rigorous regulator, with 0.925-1.026s relation samples versus the frozen 1.117s relation baseline. Implementation source deltas are +17,123 bytes in class_group_relations.py and +7,627 bytes in class_unit_groups.py (+24,750 total); the built number-field-global-arithmetic package grows only 1,254 bytes to 1,449,049/1,450,000 and all architecture ratchets pass.
risks: The isolated lane is based on the required frozen f0b22e48 benchmark commit and must be rebased onto the latest integration head before merge.

pnpm test:changed reaches the unit tier but fails the test-manifest registry because this narrow lane cannot claim the shared test registry; the same report also lists several tests added by other lanes since f0. The integration lane must register the two new steering tests.

The broader exact engine comparison has four known failures on both this lane (37 pass, 4 fail) and an exact detached f0 control (26 pass, the same 4 fail): specialized/public class_group adapter verification, a fake hR saturation record assertion, and terminal reuse. These are not G1 regressions.

A Julia comparator briefly overlapped an early native build/precompile stage. It ended before the native performance gates; all later matrix and polynomial performance thresholds passed, so no performance receipt was invalidated.
next_steps: Rebase onto the latest origin/class-group integration head, register the two focused tests in the shared test manifest, and rerun focused, strict, architecture, parallel, and changed-file validation.
Run the central number-field corpus and platform matrix, especially Windows x64 and Linux ARM64, before automatic policy expansion beyond this fixed G1 slice.
Keep candidate/log state as steering only; any future adaptive subfactor-base rotation must earn a separate measured gate and preserve authenticated replay semantics.
